quote: We continue to take mitigating actions across our buy-side and sell-side operations, including supply chain and geographic sourcing diversification, cost optimization and value engineering initiatives, targeted pricing actions, and supplier negotiations.

summary: Company attempts to pass raw material and component price increases to customers as part of cost management strategy, but success varies. This reflects ongoing margin pressure and competitive limitations on pricing flexibility.
quote: We will endeavor to pass raw material and component price increases to our customers in addition to continuing our cost management and hedging activities.

summary: Company may take incremental pricing actions to offset supply chain costs, tariff-related costs, and inflationary pressures, but tariff uncertainty may negatively influence consumer sentiment and discretionary spending behavior.
quote: We may periodically take incremental pricing actions to offset supply chain costs, increases in tariff-related costs, and inflationary pressures. In addition, prolonged tariff uncertainty may influence consumer sentiment and purchasing behavior, particularly in discretionary spending categories.

summary: While Europe achieved 2% price realization in six-month period and North America achieved 1% in quarter, negative price/cost dynamics and volume/mix declines indicate pricing power is insufficient to offset rising input costs and weak demand.
quote: The decline in Core Revenues was driven by a 3% decrease in volume/mix, partially offset by a 1% benefit from price realization.

summary: As a contract manufacturer, Flex expects to pass through tariff and component cost increases to customers via contractual mechanisms. However, ability to fully recover costs is uncertain. If unable to pass through costs, operating margins and cash flow timing would be negatively impacted.
quote: As a contract manufacturer, we expect to recover the cost of tariffs by passing tariff costs to our customers. If we are no longer able to fully pass through these tariffs, our results from operations and cash flows would be negatively impacted.

summary: Pricing power varies by segment: unfavorable price/cost in Automotive OEM (-90 bps) and Specialty Products (-160 bps), but favorable in Food Equipment and Polymers & Fluids, reflecting differential ability to pass through costs.
quote: Unfavorable price/cost of 90 basis points" in Automotive OEM and "unfavorable price/cost of 160 basis points" in Specialty Products in Q2.

summary: Company implemented pricing actions that contributed 1-3 percentage points to organic sales growth, but input cost inflation is exceeding price realization in certain segments.
quote: Pricing contributed 1 percentage points and 3 percentage points to organic growth year over year in the three and nine months ended June 30, 2026, respectively. For the three months ended June 30, 2026, pre-tax margin and Enterprise operating margin increased primarily due to higher sales volume, favorable mix, and the margin benefit of the Sensia joint venture dissolution, partially offset by negative impacts of input costs exceeding price realization.

summary: Management states ability to manage raw material costs and pass inflationary cost increases to customers, but competitive pressures limit pricing power and Packaged Meats saw volume declines.
quote: manage raw material cost movements through optimizing our hog production operations, hedging, forward purchasing, strategic sourcing negotiations and passing inflationary cost increases to customers

summary: Strong current market access observed in the U.S. with successful urologist adoption, but international revenue faces headwinds from government pricing policy uncertainties and reimbursement challenges, particularly in markets where policy shifts remain uncertain.
quote: our expectations regarding the results of market access initiatives and coverage under medical reimbursement policies; our expectations regarding the abilities of our international partners to drive commercialization of ANKTIVA in the EU and Middle East and North Africa regions

summary: Company taking pricing actions to offset input costs and tariffs, but effectiveness mixed; some regions deploying pricing promotions to support volumes, indicating price elasticity pressures.
quote: improved price and higher volumes in certain end-markets...Results in our residential and light commercial business increased (up 7%) as a result of higher volumes across the region partially offset by pricing promotions.

summary: Metal Coatings sales prices expected to modestly increase from current levels supported by input cost increases, but competitive pressures and product mix fluctuations may limit pricing gains.
quote: Sales prices in our AZZ Metal Coatings segment are expected to modestly increase from current levels, supported by continued increases in input costs. Fluctuations in product mix, along with competitive market pressures, may impact selling price.

summary: Management identifies ability to pass through tariff and cost increases as a risk factor, implying pricing power constraints.
quote: Changes in our raw material and other operating costs (such as zinc, brass, aluminum, steel and energy costs), including as a result of additional or changed tariffs on imported raw materials, and our ability to pass those costs on to our customers or offset them with reductions in other operating costs.

summary: Q2 2026 saw higher selling prices across most regions except Asia Pacific; H1 showed regional divergence with price gains in U.S., Canada, and Latin America offset by price declines in EMEA and Asia Pacific.
quote: Higher sales volume across all regions except EMEA and higher selling prices across all regions except Asia Pacific. Lower sales volume and lower selling prices in EMEA and Asia Pacific regions.

summary: Customer contracts permit periodic price adjustments for component costs, but company cannot fully recover all cost increases or may face delays. Unrecovered tariff costs expected immaterial currently.
quote: Many of our customer contracts permit periodic prospective adjustments to pricing based on decreases and increases in component prices and other factors; however, we could bear the risk of component price increases between any such re-pricing.

summary: Company's cash-pay strategy assumes pricing and marketing flexibility, but competitive products (reimbursed or not) may undercut pricing through rebates, coupons, or bundling. Changes in healthcare legislation and cost-containment measures could indirectly impact VDPHL01 pricing and profitability.
quote: Companies offering competitive products may try to compete with VDPHL01 on price both directly through rebates, promotional programs and coupons and indirectly through attractive product bundling.

summary: Management focusing on pricing discipline and margin optimization; service margin variability from event mix and strategic profitability prioritization
quote: Management continues to focus on optimizing pricing, managing marketing spend, and improving gross margins, which may result in continued variability in service revenues depending on event mix, market conditions, and the strategic prioritization of profitability over top-line growth.

summary: Gross margins affected by competitive pricing pressure alongside favorable product mix and fixed-cost absorption. Margins expected to fluctuate period-to-period.
quote: Gross margin will vary as a function of changes in pricing due to competitive pressure and gross margins will fluctuate from period to period.

summary: Durango product sales increased 3.5% due to price increases, but this was offset by a decline in packaged product sales, resulting in mixed pricing dynamics.
quote: The increase in Durango product and retail sales of 3.5%, or $0.2 million, for the three months ended May 31, 2026 compared to the three months ended May 31, 2025 was primarily due to price increases offset by a decline in packaged product sales.

summary: Wine and spirits segment implemented strategic pricing actions on select brands that generated $3.2 million decrease in net sales, indicating pricing power limitations in that segment.
quote: $3.2 million decrease from strategic pricing actions taken on select brands. Additionally, we believe our branded wine and spirits shipment volume was negatively impacted by both tariffs.

summary: AUCATZYL received EU marketing approval in July 2025, but commercial launch in Germany is on hold pending evaluation of pricing and market entry feasibility in certain EU countries.
quote: Evaluation of potential pricing and the feasibility of market entry opportunities in certain EU countries is ongoing; consequently, the commercial launch in Germany is currently on hold.

summary: Sports medicine revenue changes were entirely driven by unit volume sold rather than price changes, indicating stable pricing but volume-dependent growth.
quote: Nearly all the change in each category was due to an increase or decrease in the unit volume sold and not a result of price changes

summary: H1 2026 organic basis shows favorable net impact of price and mix of $5.7 million, but this only partially offset lower sales unit volume of $90.0 million, indicating limited pricing power in weakening demand.
quote: lower sales unit volume of $90.0 million, partially offset by the favorable combined net impact of price and mix on our overall average selling price of $5.7 million.

summary: Intrusion and access alarm division achieved ~9.1% pricing increases in fiscal 2026, but volume declined ~1.3%, indicating demand headwinds despite successful price realization.
quote: The increased revenue in our intrusion and access alarm division was primarily a result of the impact of pricing increases (approximately 9.1%), offset by a decrease in volume (approximately 1.3%).

summary: Gross margin expected to fluctuate due to changes in product mix throughout remainder of 2026.
quote: We expect our gross margin to fluctuate throughout the remainder of 2026 due to a number of factors including changes in product mix.

summary: Management indicates intent to review pricing and sales strategies in Q3 2026 in response to reduced channel sales, suggesting pricing pressure and need for strategy recalibration.
quote: The Company will continue to review its pricing and sales strategies in the third quarter of 2026.

summary: Product revenue may fluctuate based on patient demand, reimbursement, payer mix and distributor ordering patterns, creating pricing uncertainty for newly launched product.
quote: Product revenue may fluctuate based on patient demand, reimbursement, payer mix and distributor ordering patterns.

summary: ZEVASKYN pricing subject to variable consideration including payor rebates, co-payment assistance, and prompt-pay discounts. Company defers material revenue related to outcomes-based rebates and subsequent treatment discounts, creating revenue timing uncertainty.
quote: Company's contracts can include right to receive outcomes-based rebate and subsequent treatment discount of ZEVASKYN under certain conditions. Transaction consideration allocated to material right is deferred and recognized when purchase occurs or option expires.

summary: Company makes slotting fee payments to certain customers, reducing effective transaction price and indicating need to purchase retail shelf space access.
quote: The Company also provides payments to certain customers for slotting fees... the payment is not in exchange for a distinct good or service and it is therefore recognized as a reduction to the transaction price.

summary: Decrease in product costs of $7.3 million in Q2 2026 offset by increased freight costs and volume-driven product costs increases in H1 2026, indicating mixed pricing and cost pressures.
quote: Additionally, there was a decrease in product costs of $7.3 million. This was partially offset by an increase in freight costs of $3.5 million and an increase in depreciation of $1.3 million.

summary: Diagnostic services revenue faces pressure from shifting payor mix toward lower-reimbursement clients and implicit price concessions. Company actively shifting unprofitable esoteric testing to partners to improve margins.
quote: We continued to see the impact of shifting certain unprofitable but higher priced esoteric testing to our strategic partners. For the three months ended June 30, 2026, we recorded $0.9 million of negative revenue adjustments.

summary: Management expects average selling prices to fluctuate based on market conditions, product mix and currency, indicating both upside and downside pricing pressures ahead.
quote: We expect the average selling prices of our products and services to fluctuate over time based on market conditions, product mix and currency fluctuations.

summary: Pricing remains stable with no material impact from price changes on revenues, indicating neither significant pricing power nor downward pressure in current period.
quote: Price changes did not have a material impact to revenues period over period.
